definition: Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome (NEDSST; OMIM #618505) is a histone-related neurodevelopmental disorder with variable phenotypic manifestations caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in the KDM6B gene, which encodes a histone demethylase involved in epigenetic regulation.

source.title: Molecular and clinical aspects of histone-related disorders
source.quote: This neurodevelopmental syndrome is genetically heterogeneous and is associated with variable phenotypes. It occurs … X Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome 618505 AD KDM6B
